_comment: The vendored engine, and what is allowed to be different (technical-audit_2026-08-25 N14).
engine/ holds byte-for-byte copies of files whose source of truth is one of
the two map skills. This file is what lets community-bus-maps notice on its
own that a copy has been edited or has gone stale, without the skill trees
being present — the gap N14 named: until 2026-08-25 the only drift check
lived in the SKILLS repository, so a developer working only in the portal
could not find out that engine/icons.js had diverged from its source.
EVERY .js file under engine/ must appear here, as `vendored` (with a source
and a hash) or `portal-owned` (with a reason). A file on disk that is not
named here FAILS scripts/check-vendored.mjs. That rule is the finding: the
skills-side check listed eleven files while the tree held sixteen, and one of
the five nobody was watching — area/gen_external_radial.js — had been stale
since 2026-08-21, missing the March X32 badge-overlap fix and the sheetQr
default. A list you must remember to extend is not a control.
`sha256` is taken over CRLF-NORMALISED bytes, the same rule the skills'
sameIgnoringLineEndings() uses, so a checkout under core.autocrlf=true does
not report the whole tree as drifted.
AFTER A DELIBERATE RE-VENDOR: copy the file, then run
node scripts/check-vendored.mjs --update
from the repository root, and commit the manifest change WITH the file. The
hash moving in the diff is the point — it is what tells a reviewer that a
vendored file changed, rather than the change arriving silently.
See engine/README.md, engine/area/README.md, engine/place/README.md and the
skill's references/changing-the-engine.md §4 for the hand-off itself.

It arrived with design.laneOrientation on 2026-08-26 and this row had to be written by hand: --update restamps rows that exist, and until a file is named here it is not a row, so nothing could go red about a file the portal did not have yet. That is the hole requireScan() now covers.
